sources.title: Meta Llama 3.1 405B Instruct - Meta | Model Documentation
sources.snippet: Description Llama 3.1 405B Instruct is Meta's largest and most capable open-source language model, representing their flagship offering in the Llama 3.1 series. This 405-billion parameter model features a 128K token context window and demonstrates competitive performance against leading closed-source models including GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet in benchmark evaluations.
